prose: The fifth installment of our Loki series might be the most jam packed yet. Themes of purgatory, penance, the Wheel of Fortune, and the Void all revolve around this episode, along with more clues to the artificial history timeline. There's even a homunculus in this one! Tune in to find out what the many alternate Lokis and the giant smoke monster at the end of time represent in occultism.
